You call on the gods of war and protection. A line of white fire draws itself across the ground, and the air smells of iron and lightning.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
A straight line starting from a point you can see within 5 squares.
Duration
Until the start of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per scene.
Type
Signature
Weak
3 squares long; 1 radiant damage.
Standard
5 squares long; 2 radiant damage.
Strong
7 squares long; 3 radiant damage. The line is 1 square wide and lasts until the start of your next turn. You and allies you choose when you create it are unaffected. A creature takes the damage when the line appears in its square, when it enters a square of the line, or when it starts its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn. The line does not block movement.

Additional rulings
